claim: Can I delete Synapse while keeping my mouse settings?
summary: Shut off Synapse and see what happens. That's how your mouse will work if you uninstall it. It really depends on the mouse. Some have internal memory and can save some settings, but usually not all settings. You can check this in Synapse on the mouse page where the profiles are.
